articles.summary: Two people were injured during a car crash that happened in Mississauga Monday night. Emergency crews were called to the Erindale area, near Mississauga Road and Featherston Drive, just after 8 p.m. for reports of a two-vehicle collision. articles.title: Father tells court he feels loss every day after son killed outside Scarborough gas station
articles.summary: The father of a tow truck driver killed outside a Scarborough gas station told a court on Monday he feels the loss of his son every single day.

articles.title: Family pleads for safe return of beloved bunny Biscuit after pet goes missing at Markham Fair
articles.summary: A Toronto family says it's "devastated" after their beloved pet bunny Biscuit went missing at the annual Markham Fair, with both the family and fair organizers saying they believe he was stolen.

articles.title: 2 charged, 1 suspect outstanding in connection with death of Scarborough man found inside burning vehicle
articles.summary: Two people have been arrested and one suspect remains outstanding in connection with the death of a Scarborough man found inside a burning vehicle in September, Toronto police say.

articles.summary: Investigators with the Durham Regional Police Service (DRPS) believe three suspects who allegedly used phony documents to purchase three vehicles before fleeing the country without paying for them are part of an organized group involved in criminal tourism. articles.summary: Toronto police have arrested and charged two people in connection with the murder of a 32-year-old man whose body was discovered inside a burning vehicle in Scarborough last month, while a third suspect remains wanted on a Canada-wide warrant. articles.title: Crown says DNA evidence helped ID man now on trial for decades-old sex assaults against children
articles.summary: Prosecutors told a jury in Brampton, Ont., on Monday, how DNA evidence had linked three brutal attacks against children in the 1990s to Richard Neil, now 67 and on trial for charges including kidnapping, sexual assault causing bodily harm and administering a stupefying drug.

articles.title: 3 candidates vying for front-runner status ahead of Mississauga election: poll
articles.summary: It's going to be a tight mayoral race in Mississauga with three candidates, including the current and former mayors, now neck and neck among decided and leaning voters, a new poll suggests.

articles.title: Water main break, flooding closes down Scarborough intersection
articles.summary: A water main break and sinkhole have closed down a busy Scarborough intersection early Monday morning, police said.

articles.title: Highway 400 to be expanded, including 1 HOV lane in each direction, near King, Ont.: province
articles.summary: Ontario's Highway 400 is set to be expanded near the King township, north of Toronto, the province announced Monday.

articles.title: 'Heartbreaking reality': Crew, passengers of downed medical transport jet are likely dead, company says
articles.summary: The decision by the U.S. Coast Guard to end the search for the crew and passengers of a medical transport jet out of Hamilton, Ont., means it's time to accept that the four Canadians and two Bermudians on board didn't survive, says the company that operated the jet.

articles.title: Man accused in massive gold heist at Toronto's Pearson airport pleads not guilty as trial begins
articles.summary: A man accused in what investigators have called one of the largest gold heists in Canadian history has pleaded not guilty to two charges as his trial begins in Brampton, Ont.

articles.title: This heritage home may be paying the price of Toronto's electricity needs
articles.summary: A 145-year-old home near Kensington Market may soon be demolished — despite its status as a listed heritage site — after the building was reportedly bought earlier this year by Hydro One.

articles.title: Kaylee Hunter's late goal lifts AFC Toronto over Vancouver Rise
articles.summary: Kaylee Hunter scored in the 100th minute as AFC Toronto edged the visiting Vancouver Rise 2-1 on Sunday at York Lions Stadium.
